reviewer: Independent verifier lane, separate from documentation and archive authors
scope: Documentation, metadata, archival integrity, local session hygiene and recorded sidebar outcomes
execution: One integrated documentation/session verification sweep after the complete author batch; three broken historical citations were repaired together, followed only by targeted verification of the two changed community documents.

checks.name: Session archive integrity
checks.detail: Exact archived SHA-256 and byte counts match the manifest; content also matches original tracked source after line-ending normalization.

checks.name: Local recovery state
checks.detail: Three former session markers and the original log match recorded SHA-256 and byte counts; current markers are inactive historical pointers to their originals.

checks.name: Local session log retention
checks.detail: Retained entries exactly match the original entries in the retained date range.

checks.name: Runbook preservation
checks.detail: September runbook retains the complete original body; historical-backfill and offline-export incident bodies remain unchanged.

checks.name: Current registry and metadata
checks.detail: Registry rows match track metadata and status-bearing specification/plan frontmatter.

checks.name: JSON and OKF
checks.detail: Changed/new JSON parses and maintained Conductor Markdown declares type frontmatter. Immutable original archive records preserve historical source bytes.

checks.name: Maintained local links and anchors
checks.detail: Integrated sweep checked maintained Markdown links/anchors. Three existing broken community citations were repaired to preserved migrations and the current panel successor; targeted follow-up checked all 15 local links in those two files plus exact cited line content.

checks.name: Sidebar ledger consistency
checks.detail: Tracked ledger exactly matches its original local audit. All 40 archived IDs match recorded archived-list confirmations; no requested archive remains visible and no retained task is missing. Current task remains retained.

checks.name: Whitespace
checks.detail: git diff --check passed for the integrated batch and for the subsequent two-file citation repair.

checks.name: Independent content review
checks.detail: No incomplete parent was closed. Current recovery, source-direct ownership, historical-gap, selected-day reader, rendering, burn-in and acceptance gates remain named; completed slices and old operational measurements are dated.

resolved_findings: Repointed two old Drizzle migration citations to preserved drizzle/archive originals.
Replaced the retired CommunityPanel citation with CommunityDetails.tsx query and review-note evidence.
Added a September 11 community plan notice distinguishing remaining moderation/ML decisions from the historical August 5 phase table and concurrent-session warning.
limitations: This is a documentation and session-hygiene receipt, not an application test, Python quality, release or production acceptance receipt.
Sidebar verification checks the independently captured tool audit and outcome ledger; this verifier did not issue fresh sidebar mutations or app listing calls.
Sidebar discovery is limited to the app's visible window of at most 50 non-pinned tasks without pagination; inaccessible older tasks are not claimed audited.
Immutable archived historical bodies retain original commands, statuses, relative citations and line references; current entry-point notices define their historical interpretation.
Ignored local recovery archives and referenced source artifacts remain local; a tracked hash records their identity but does not embed those source artifacts in Git.
